BLOCKS_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Blocks identified by a numero (Id) must remain below this limit (confirmed via the official update notes Eleon v1.17 -- 2048 and then 4096 are historical values of now perimes).
To add a block to this limit, do not put any Id at all -- only uses 'Block Name: MyBloc' (identifies by name, not by number).
Affirmation frequently repeated in the community, but not confirmed despite search -- possible confusion with BlockColor, which actually uses a range 0-255 (RGB values). Treat with caution.
The indicated mass corresponds to a block of 1 metre. The game then automatically adjusts it according to the real size of the block:
Real mass = value indicated x 8 (block of 2m)
On which types of structure this block can be laid (Base, MS, SS, GV, Terrain).
What types of objects collide with this block (movement, bullets, rockets, body, target). Remove 'movement' for example makes the block traversable on foot while remaining touchable by the weapons.
List of 6 texture numeros, in order: above, below, north, south, west, east.
A block can only herit (Ref) from a DEJA DEFINI block higher in the file (Id or smaller position) -- never from a lower block.
Reuse an existing icon for the display in play (e.g. 'CustomIcon: DetectorSVT1').
Item that will be automatically placed in the player's inventory when collecting this block/device. Only works on the PARENT block, never on a sub-block ('child').

Indicates which craft recipe (Templates.ecf) to use for this sub-group -- useful for the UPLOAD function. The parent block does not need it (it always uses the recipe with its own name). CAUTION: Never make a Ref to a block that IS even the target of TemplateRoot in the same entry -- it makes the blueprint library crash.

Defines to which block/device this block turns in case of upgrade. If you put this on a subgroup, this subgroup needs its own TemplateRoot, otherwise the upgrade will be free (bug). May be 'null' to avoid a loop.
Same principle as UpgradeTo, but in the other direction (back to back).
The block can't be turned at pose.
The block is automatically oriented according to the target surface (paste/orientate correctly), but only rotation around an axis is possible.
Set free, all possible rotations, but without automatic alignment (less practical, often requires manual rotations).
If active (true), this block disappears immediately when the structure collapses (loss of integritis).
Enables/deactivates fine physical collisions (sometimes on too thin ramps).
The block occupies its entire volume even if it is not 'voxelise' (useful for blocks with animation or special shader).
2 for SV/HV, 8 for CV/BA -- used to scale the mass and life points according to the number of voxels.
Determines whether the block is cut into small cubes rather than occupy a whole voxel at once (true by default).
The block can be switched on/off by the player.
Accessible via the Control Panel (tower, tank, safe...).
The block is already lit as soon as it is laid.
The block can be used with drawing tools in plan/line.
Force the MaxCount limit even if the difficulty level had deactivated it (useful for Core, Warp Drive... but not for weapons).
The degats/PV of this aircraft only count against the infantry and entites, not facing the artillery.
Reserve at Cores (PNJ only): Preplace content is saved with blueprint and becomes loot.
Only for Class:ShieldGenerator -- a free text that can be used in the Multiplier Damage of a weapon (ItemsConfig.ecf).
Put false to exclude a special/rare block from automatic repair via recipe (avoid abuse).
Put a 'False' so that an important object of history is never lost at the death of the player (true by default).
Reputation multiplier wins/loses by destroying this block (e.g. 0.1 to reduce impact).
3D model of bag/container displays on the floor when this block is lacquered (variants: small, large, event...).
What variant of container appears when a spoil container is destroyed.
Delai in seconds before the shield starts reloading after a stroke (5s per default).
Start a state of dialogue (Dialogues.ecf) when the player looks at the block and presses F.
Same thing, but touching/pushing against the block rather than pressing F.
Only one player can interact with this dialogue.
Force a precise dialogue; also allows to place this block on a player-owned basis (decended via F).
Hide the yellow cone of dialogue over the NPC (useful if the NPC only barks without real interaction).
Use in Dialogues.ecf to define a skill entry. Values can change: degats, zone degats, dispersion, reloading delay, recoil, carrier...
All manufacturers, including the food processor.
Symmetric shape quarter round type (by default).
Shape type bevel corner, but with incorrect default rotation (orthogonal to Z axis).
Block uses when it is mirrored.
Decor objects without structural integrite (the same as Device but without SI).
Like Device, but with a constant luminous effect (e.g. solar panels).
New coloring method for Device blocks.
New coloring method for decorative objects.
List of objects that can be used to fill a bottle of oxygen (the first one on the list is used as a priority).
List of objects that can be used as fuel (the first item on the list is used as a priority).
GALAXY_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: From Territory 1 to Territory 20 maximum, each may have 1 to 10 additional 'Other ' factions (Other 1 to Other 10).
Adds a 2nd decorative foil (no gameplay) to a StarClass -- the value must be a StarClass already defined in that file.
Force the use of a SolarSystemConfig file<suffixe>.yaml particular instead of the type of star by default.

SunBlueGiant, SunWhiteDwarf, SunYellowWhite, SunYellow, SunRedGiant, SunRedDwarf, SunNeutron, BlackHole, SunGeneric. Only the visual model is limited to this list -- all other parameters (StarClass, color...) remain customizable.

If the scenario does not use fixed sectors.yaml with starting planets, a departure system can be defined in general settings. A sectors.yaml with departure planets is priority on this entry if both exist.
= 10,000 AU = 100,000 sectors (simplified value for readability, not true astronomical measurement).
Territories, position of a star (sectors.yaml), galactic spawn radius, galaxy radius.
Areas around a star (e.g. HabitableCold), position of a planet/moon/station in sectors.yaml or SolarSystemConfig -- NOT in AU.
Zirax, Talon, Polaris, Kriel, Pirates, Trader, UCH, Civilian, Alien.
Several territories may exist for the same faction, even with overlapping coordinates/spheres.
Only its own POI is placed in the territory by default; To authorize others, use 'Other ' with a numero, defining the probability from the centre to the edge.
Text of the label to this position.
Distance (in light years) from which the label is hidden.
If defined in a StarRegion, activate the aleatory nebulas -- only those of regions using this property appear.
Chooses the colour of the nebula in the corresponding NebulaColor degrade (up to 30 possible degrades).
Loads a backup part, edits its Galaxyconfig.efc in the backup folder, then reloads with the 'galaxy' console command.
The system remains visible on the map but no longer appears in the search.
Star name -- customizable, or generic '<StarClass> Type Star'.
0 a 1 -- overall probability that this class exists in the galaxy (never set 0).
1 a 12 -- size of star and its icon, influences the distance of warp areas for large stars.
Star colours (map, appearance in play, inner color, crown).
Purely informative, no effect on the game.
Distance ranges (in AU) defining each area of the system -- then used in sectors.yaml to place planets.
Min/max distance (in light years) from the centre for this star to appear.
Number of stars of this type placed in the galaxy -- put 0 only if gere via the REGIONS.
Short scientific/narrative description for the map.
ITEMS_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Reuse an existing icon for the display in play.
Restricted use, e.g. 'AllowAt: NoPvP' and 'AllowAt: NoPvE' to prohibit an object according to the game mode.
Unit price for POI 'StationInterface'. If several objects fill the same role (e.g. 3 types of batteries for fuel), the lowest cost is used automatically.
Duree in seconds before a floor-wash object disappears (200s per default). Increasing only if absolutely necessary -- too many ground objects degrades performance.
Put a 'False' so that an important object of history is never lost at the death of the player (true by default).
Syntax: "StatusID, FactorDuree, FactorIntensite, CancelAExpiration(optional)". The duration/intensite factor modifies the time/force of the effect (0 = no change).
Boolean that prevents the end-of-status effects so true -- e.g., a medicine that prevents an infected injury from unfolding in sepsis.
Maximum 15 entries per armor. Please note: changing this list changes the boosters already active in existing parts (storage by INDEX in this list).
PowerFac / SpeedFac / StaminaFac / JetpackFac / JumpFac / FoodFac
Multiplier for energy, speed, endurance, jetpack, jump, food consumption.
The damage is defined on the weapon itself; the type of munition carries only stats (mass, volume, cost...).
Degats AND degats of zone (optional) defined on the type of ammunition (sub-entry 'Class: Projectile').
ADD to the base data for the central block button. Approximate formula: (Degats + DegatsZone) - (DegatsZone / RayonZone).
head, body, dirt, stone, rock, metallight, metal, metalhard, woodsoft, woodhard, concrete, hull, hullarmored, hullcombat, shield.
Percentage (0.0-1.0) of normal degats/area across the shield.
Radius and intensity of zone degas, and what visual effect to use (1-16).
Zone damage does NOT apply to a shield -- only base damage counts.
On a Class:ShieldGenerator (BlocksConfig.ecf), free value reusable in a DamageMultiplier to specifically target this type of shield.
Raw matter without recipe (remasses in the world).
Fuse with lower shooting animation (survival tool, multi-tool, drill).
Allows/prohibits the use of drone player (real by default).
GLOBALDEFS_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Defining common values (e.g., degass of a weapon, life points of a drone) A ONLY LEFT here, and then reusing them in any other ECF file -- changing the value here is enough to change it anywhere.
In another file (e.g., ItemsConfig.ecf), use 'GlobalRef: Defname' to refer to this value.
A same block can use multiple GlobalDef via GlobalRef 1 up to GlobalRef 5.
LOOT_GROUPS_GLOSSARY: Item x: name, data: quantite[-plage], xdata: probabilities (x increments for each line; use quotes if quantite is a beach).
MATERIAL_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Can't be destroyed by most hand-held weapons.
Maximum current length of a horizontal beam = 12 blocks.
Determines the maximum number of aline blocks that will not detach due to loss of structural integritis.
STATUS_EFFECTS_GLOSSARY: Consolidate everything an enemy routinely inflicts.
Warms alone without treatment, in 240 life points.
TEMPLATES_GLOSSARY: Put ALL lines in Child Inputs a 0 -- never delete the entire section.
Defines the basic level for the blueprints factory, and serves as reference for R2T repair.
Decomposes an object until it gets only basic brands. Ex: Iron ore (BaseItem) will never be recreated from iron ingot.
Authorizes the deconstructor to decompose the object an additional step.
Prevents any deconstruction of this object.
Using a T1 device as an ingredient of a T2 device only works for unique devices (e.g. Builder), not for block groups (e.g. Cockpits) -- do not use the T1 ingredient in this case.
TOKEN_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: A token (Token) is an instance of the 'GenericToken' item that takes its meaning into play -- e.g. the code of a locked door, or a PDA quete/mission requiring this token to finish.
True, remove the token from the player's inventory as it is used.
No need to define each token here, but if defined, its name and description will display correctly.
1. Placer un jeton dans un conteneur
Console: 'give item Token 0001', then place it in a container and save the POI (only works with a core admin currently).
Use 'Token:0001' as a reward or inventory operation in a PDA mission.
AddItem function, ex: AddItem('KeyCardBlack', 3, 1234) gives 3 cards with Meta 1234.
Add the item to the TraderNPCCongig.efc using 'Token:0001' as the item name.
Same principle, use 'Token:0001' in the LootGroups.ecf.
Only this item can receive a 4-digit Meta. No other 'keycard' or similar object can have Meta attach.
The console command 'token reload' applies changes to this file without restarting the game.
TRADER_NPC_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Name of item, sale price range, stock range available[, purchase price range, maximum stock range].
If omitted, the merchant does not purchase this item.
If the merchant buys the item (maximum stock defined), the reference price corresponds to a current stock equal to half the stock max. More stock = lower price, less stock = higher price.
If the merchant only sells the item, the price does not depend on the stock.
The purchase price can overlap the sale price -- the game guarantees when even a margin of at least 5% for the merchant.
Allows to apply a factor to the basic walking price.
Do not change the name of the merchant provided by default.
BLOCK_GROUPS_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Define a group of individualized blocks sharing a common limit -- useful for balancing, for example, the total number of turrets.
The blocks of the group respect both the limit of the group AND their own individual limit (defined in BlocksConfig.ecf).
On blocks with an index (a digital Id).
Add a corresponding line in Localization.csv (ex: 'SVWeapons,Total SV Weapons {0},...') to display the limit in the interface -- nothing else to add in BlocksConfig.ecf.
Name of the group, total limit, and list of relevant blocks separated by commas.
CONTAINERS_GLOSSARY: "Group" (x is incremented), data: "probability" [, xdata="quantity range"] (by default 1,1).
Always use 8 columns currently (first number of the line 'Size').

Enter the Id number of the container (ex: 255) in the drop-down menu next to the spawn-entity.
DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Define groups of degat multipliers reusable from ItemsConfig.ecf via 'DamageMultiplier Group: Name ofGroup'.
Une seule methode a la fois
In ItemsConfig.ecf, use either DamageMultiplier x RIGHT DamageMultiplier Group, not both.
One 'Collection' combines several groups -- but one group cannot refer to another.
x5 of damage to the head.
No damage on these soil/wall materials.
DEF_REPUTATION_GLOSSARY: Replaces reputation by default of all factions of origin (Origin) towards PNJ factions.
EGROUPS_CONFIG_GLOSSARY: Creature factions are defined in EClassConfig.ecf, not here.
Appear together and interact as a team (behavioral AI).
FACTIONS_GLOSSARY: Must be unique, uses in backups -- changing it breaks existing parts. Must be < 100, otherwise a FACT JEWELL is created instead. Holes in the numbering are allowed.
Without special spaces or characteristics -- usable in localization. A reference for playfields, POI, etc.
"R,G,B" -- divide the RGB value by 255 to obtain the expected float.
Displays at the top of the list for NPC factions.
Factions like Legacy or Alien -- impossible to improve its reputation with them.
Always friendly -- DefReputation.ecf ignores, do not combine with 'Reputation: true'.
Factions like the Zirax -- reputation, own territory, improvement/degradation possible.
Enables the Reputation Matrix of DefReputation.ecf. Otherwise, the faction is hostile static (unless FriendlyToPlayers is active).
The faction can have a visual territory on the planets (without connection to the galactic territories, geres in galaxy.ecf).
Hide the faction of the map legend.
Hides the abstraction of the faction in the interface (HUD).
The faction becomes discoverable as one of its POI is discovered. Debug via the console command 'faction discover <faction>'.
This faction attacks other PNJ factions with this active option.
List of specifically attacked factions (may be asymetric) -- crushes AttackNPC's behavior.
A faction is either static or dynamic -- never both.
Zirax, Talon, Alien, Polaris, Prey, Predator and Admin are managed internally (references/values per default) and are not customizable.
Zirax, Polaris, Trader, Colonists, Eden Defender.
Warlord, Alien, TheLegacy, Kriel, Eden Drone, Eden DroneHome, Pirates.
Never modify them (except color) -- must be defined before any other faction in the file.
FACTION_WARFARE_GLOSSARY: Global for a whole faction on a given POI -- impossible to configure a specific ship for a specified POI via SBD.
Exclure un POI de la SBD
In the yaml playfield, use SpaceDefenseOverrideDefaults: True with SpaceDefenseProbability: 1.0 and SpaceDefensePriceMinMax: [30, 60] -- or fix a probability specified (0-1) otherwise managed by AI.
Converts a level number to attack wave price.
Defines an individual unit usable in an attack scenario, stored in a category (e.g. several drone forces minigun depending on the difficulty).
Defines the complete composition of an attack -- automatically usable by the basic attack system, or manually via a PDA mission.
